nodes.description: Private balance mapping `_router` holding token balances of every address.
Nested mapping `_allowances` storing owner->spender approved amounts.
Public `public_address` used as a whitelisted/route address (set through addliquidity).
Public `caller` address variable set by the owner via Approve(); used in _transfer restriction check.
Private `_reflectMax` total supply variable, initialised to 10^28 and mutated by setreflectrate.
Public `rTotal` threshold variable, settable arbitrarily by the owner through reflect().
Private `_owner` address that gates the onlyOwner modifier.
Public duplicate of the owner address, written by the constructor and renounceOwnership.
Constructor of TokyoREVENGERS: assigns initial supply to msg.sender and sets _owner/Owner.
Context._call() internal view returning msg.sender as address payable.
Public ERC20 transfer that delegates to _transfer with msg.sender as sender.
Public ERC20 transferFrom: moves tokens then deducts allowance via _approve.
Public ERC20 approve that calls _approve(msg.sender, spender, amount).
Public view returning allowance of spender for owner.
Internal _transfer performing balance bookkeeping and the caller/public_address restriction.
Private _approve overwriting the allowance mapping and emitting Approval.
Owner-only function that increases _reflectMax and the owner's balance by an arbitrary amount.
Owner-only function that overwrites rTotal with an arbitrary value.
Owner-only function writing an arbitrary address into the `caller` state variable.
Owner-only function writing an arbitrary address into `public_address`.
Public view returning _router[account].
Public view returning _reflectMax.
onlyOwner modifier comparing _owner with _call() (msg.sender).
Owner-only function setting Owner (and logically _owner) to address(0).
Owner-only function assigning _owner to newOwner.
msg.sender, surfaced through Context._call() and used for ownership, transfers and approvals.
Balance sub/add on _router inside _transfer together with the caller/public_address transfer restriction.
Unconditional overwrite of _allowances[owner][spender] inside _approve.
Owner can mint arbitrary new supply to itself by increasing _reflectMax and _router balance.
Owner can set `caller` and `public_address` to arbitrary addresses, altering transfer restrictions.
Owner can set rTotal arbitrarily, changing the transfer amount requirement.
recipient parameter of transfer().
amount parameter of transfer().
sender parameter of transferFrom().
recipient parameter of transferFrom().
amount parameter of transferFrom().
spender parameter of approve().
amount parameter of approve().
routeUniswap parameter of Approve(), written into `caller`.
Uniswaprouterv02 parameter of addliquidity(), written into public_address.
reflectionPercent parameter of reflect(), scaled by 10**18 into rTotal.
amount parameter of setreflectrate(), added to _reflectMax and owner balance.
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership().
account parameter of balanceOf().
owner parameter of allowance().
spender parameter of allowance().
Local variable `call` in the constructor holding _call()/msg.sender.

edges.reason: _call() returns msg.sender, the untrusted caller identity.
Constructor reads _call() to determine the initial owner and supply holder.
Local `call` is assigned from _call() inside the constructor.
Constructor writes the private _owner state variable used by onlyOwner.
Constructor writes the public Owner state variable.
Constructor mints the entire initial supply into _router[msg.sender].
onlyOwner compares _owner with _call(), i.e. with msg.sender.
transfer() passes _call()/msg.sender as the sender to _transfer.
transferFrom() uses _call()/msg.sender as the spender when deducting allowance.
approve() passes _call()/msg.sender as the allowance owner.
setreflectrate() requires _call() != address(0) and mints to msg.sender.
transfer() delegates execution to internal _transfer.
recipient parameter flows through transfer() into _transfer.
amount parameter flows through transfer() into _transfer.
transferFrom() performs the token movement by calling _transfer.
transferFrom() calls _approve to deduct the used allowance.
sender parameter is forwarded from transferFrom() to _transfer.
recipient parameter is forwarded from transferFrom() to _transfer.
amount parameter is used both in _transfer and in the allowance subtraction.
transferFrom() reads _allowances[sender][msg.sender] to subtract the spent allowance.
approve() delegates to private _approve.
spender parameter flows from approve() into _approve.
amount parameter flows from approve() into _approve.
_approve overwrites _allowances[owner][spender] with the supplied amount.
allowance() reads the _allowances mapping.
owner parameter indexes _allowances in allowance().
spender parameter indexes _allowances in allowance().
balanceOf() returns the balance stored in _router.
account parameter indexes _router in balanceOf().
totalSupply() returns the mutable _reflectMax supply variable.
_transfer subtracts from _router[sender] and adds to _router[recipient].
_transfer reads the owner-controlled `caller` variable in its restriction check.
_transfer compares recipient with the owner-controlled public_address.
_transfer compares amount against the owner-controlled rTotal threshold.
sender is the parameter used to debit _router balance inside _transfer.
recipient is the parameter credited inside _transfer.
amount is the parameter applied to balances inside _transfer.
setreflectrate adds an arbitrary amount to _reflectMax (supply inflation).
setreflectrate increases the owner's _router balance with an arbitrary amount.
amount parameter is added to _reflectMax and to the owner balance without cap.
reflect multiplies reflectionPercent by 10**18 and stores it in rTotal.
reflectionPercent parameter is scaled by 10**18 when writing rTotal.
Approve sets the privileged `caller` variable used by _transfer checks.
routeUniswap parameter is written verbatim into the caller state variable.
addliquidity sets the privileged public_address variable.
Uniswaprouterv02 parameter is written verbatim into public_address.
setreflectrate is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
reflect is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
Approve is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
addliquidity is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership reassigns the private _owner address.
newOwner parameter becomes the new _owner without renouncing old privileges.
renounceOwnership zeroes the public Owner variable but not _owner.
_transfer executes the balance mutation operation.
sender balance is reduced by amount in the mutation operation.
recipient balance is increased by amount in the mutation operation.
amount drives the sub/add balance arithmetic, gated only by rTotal.
approve() reaches the allowance overwrite operation.
_approve performs the allowance overwrite operation.
setreflectrate performs the supply-increasing operation.
addliquidity performs the privileged public_address assignment.
Approve performs the privileged caller assignment.
reflect performs the arbitrary rTotal assignment.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is only a transient parameter of transfer(); it carries no independent security semantics and should be folded into the transfer function node.
amount is a transient parameter of transfer() that flows directly into _transfer; fold it into the transfer function node.
sender is a transient parameter of transferFrom() forwarded to _transfer; fold into transferFrom.
recipient is a transient parameter of transferFrom(); fold into transferFrom.
amount is a transient parameter of transferFrom() used for balance and allowance updates; fold into transferFrom.
spender is a transient parameter of approve() forwarded to _approve; fold into approve.
amount is a transient parameter of approve(); fold into approve.
routeUniswap is only used to set the caller state variable inside Approve(); fold into the Approve function node.
Uniswaprouterv02 is only used to set public_address inside addliquidity(); fold into addliquidity.
reflectionPercent only feeds the rTotal arithmetic inside reflect(); fold into reflect.
amount directly drives the supply-inflation operation in setreflectrate(); merge it into that unsafe operation node.
newOwner is only used to reassign _owner inside transferOwnership(); fold into transferOwnership.
account is only a mapping lookup key in the balanceOf view; fold into balanceOf.
owner is only a lookup key in the allowance view; fold into allowance.
spender is only a lookup key in the allowance view; fold into allowance.
the local `call` variable is a temporary alias of msg.sender inside the constructor and should be folded into the constructor node.
